definitions.explanation: The artificial supply of water to land or crops to assist in growing, especially in areas with insufficient rainfall.

examples.japanese: {灌漑|かんがい}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{灌漑|かんがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Irrigation is indispensable in arid regions.

examples.japanese: {灌漑|かんがい}⟦{用水路|ようすいろ}→用水路：19104_yousuiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧。

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{灌|かん}→灌：noentry⟧ (pour, water) + ⟦{漑|がい}→漑：noentry⟧ (irrigate). Both characters relate to water supply for agriculture.

NOTE ON KANJI: The characters ⟦{灌|かん}→灌：noentry⟧ and ⟦{漑|がい}→漑：noentry⟧ are rarely used outside this compound. Sometimes written as ⟦{潅漑|かんがい}→潅漑：noentry⟧ (with simplified ⟦{潅|かん}→潅：noentry⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {灌漑|かんがい}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧ (irrigation facilities)
- {灌漑|かんがい}⟦{用水|ようすい}→用水：29725_yousui⟧ (irrigation water)
- {灌漑|かんがい}⟦{用水路|ようすいろ}→用水路：19104_yousuiro⟧ (irrigation canal)
- {灌漑|かんがい}⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧ (irrigated agriculture)
- {灌漑|かんがい}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧ (irrigation system)

HISTORICAL CONTEXT: Japan has a long history of irrigation systems for rice cultivation, including ⟦{用水路|ようすいろ}→用水路：19104_yousuiro⟧ (irrigation canals) and ⟦{溜|た}め{池|いけ}→溜め池：29726_tameike⟧ (irrigation ponds).
